concerns.text: The plan's Verified Datasets block lists a second dataset — 'CodeSearchNet Python (test split)' (kejian/codesearchnet-python-rebalanced, test-00000-of-00001-3967e86c21fe91c3.parquet) — but no task downloads, validates, or uses it. T001 only fetches the train shard. Either add a task covering the test split (e.g., for US-2's 'validation snippets' fixtures) or remove it from the plan's verified sources so every plan element has a matching task.
